reviews.text: I felt much more at ease after they kindly and thoroughly explained my condition using models and other visual aids. Thank you very much.
A sign at the entrance said they didn't accept credit cards, so I decided to go to my usual hospital. It seems they only accept cash.

I've been a patient of this doctor since the clinic opened. I've sought their help many times with my cat's urinary stones, and they've always been a lifesaver.

The head doctor and the nurses are a fantastic pair; they're truly the best doctors. When I consulted them after my kittens were born, they helped me find adoptive homes for them, and I'm incredibly grateful.

This is a truly conscientious hospital that avoids unnecessary expenses.

I've moved and it's become difficult for me to continue coming here, so I had to take my last cat to another hospital.

Recently, I had eight cats, and I'd forgotten their birthdays, but even though I knew they were busy, I called and they kindly reminded me, for which I am very grateful.

All my cats are gone now, but this doctor treated almost all of them!

Thank you so much!

This is a long message, but I wanted to express my gratitude here.

I've been a patient here for a long time. They listen carefully to what I have to say and provide appropriate treatment.

It's popular and often crowded, so I recommend going with plenty of time to spare.
Their kind consideration eased my anxiety and I was very pleased with their courteous service.

My cat wasn't feeling well, so I went to the vet during their business hours. However, the door was locked, so I called from in front of the vet, but they said, "Can't you see inside the vet from the outside? We're full of other customers, so we can't help you," and hung up immediately. I took my cat to another vet right away, so she's fine, but the service was terrible. I never expected to be told something like that when I went during business hours. I will never go there again.

This is a very good hospital that provides compassionate care. 
They take care of every little detail, so I feel at ease. 
I've visited several pet clinics, but I've finally found one I can trust.
I trust them because they listen carefully to what owners have to say and examine pets thoroughly.
